title: docs: apply README front-door standard v0.4 (§5.1)
description:
Standard (authoritative, recommended (not ddl-managed)): https://github.com/charly-vibes/dulce-de-leche/blob/main/docs/standardization.md#51-readme-front-door-contract

Audit (2026-11-15): 0/10. README is 'A charly-vibes project.'

Repo-specific gaps:
- No idea, state, or next pointer for a repo that is explicitly in gestation.

Required changes:
- [ ] Add `## When to use` with use bullets, 'use <sibling> instead' bullets, and the assumption the tool makes.
- [ ] Make `## Quick start` install → first meaningful command → expected output.
- [ ] Add `## FAQ` (5–7 questions) or link `docs/src/faq.md` / `docs/src/troubleshooting.md` from the README first screen.
- [ ] Move repository-development recipes (`just …`, build-from-source) to `## Development`.
- [ ] Fix broken relative README links (if any).
- [ ] Add one paragraph on the idea and what would make it start.

Acceptance: §5.1 checklist passes; every documented command exists in `--help`; no broken relative links.

Release note: §1 now requires prebuilt binaries on GitHub Releases for binary tools (five targets + checksums.txt); non-binary repos record the deviation in `docs/src/status.md`.

Context: fleet README audit 2026-11-15 (45 repos); umbrella epic `charly-o1j`.
